parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The name of the custom header.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value of the custom header.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn set-req-header-config --domain-name example.com --key testkey --value testvalue --config-id 123 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn SetReqHeaderConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --Value testvalue --ConfigId 123 --Key testkey
